tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:

tr.td: The patient shows significant anemia with low hemoglobin and hematocrit, but normal red cell indices (MCV, MCH, MCHC), suggesting normocytic, normochromic anemia. Leukocyte and platelet counts are within normal limits, though platelet distribution width is elevated, possibly indicating increased platelet size variability. Further evaluation for causes of anemia (e.g., blood loss, chronic disease) is recommended.
